sources.sweepWidthFactor: SOURCED: W = 1.645 x Rd, Koester et al. 2014, Wilderness Environ Med 25(2) (docs/evidence/search-math-sources.md)
sources.sweepSpeedMps: SOURCED: median sweep speed, Hashimoto et al. 2026, PLoS One 21(6): e0339541 (docs/evidence/search-math-sources.md)
sources.hastySpeedMps: SOURCED: median hasty speed, Hashimoto et al. 2026, PLoS One 21(6): e0339541 (docs/evidence/search-math-sources.md)
sources.secondsPerMinute: unit conversion: reports give minutes, track length uses seconds
sources.iocBase: OURS: PLS v1 likelihood table (CASIE Table 7 not read)
sources.coverageRatioMax: OURS: a stated coverage from 0 to 3 is a ratio
sources.coveragePercentMax: OURS: a stated coverage above 3 and up to 300 is a percentage
sources.detectionProfile: SOURCED: ISRID dementia profile, about 1% respond to shouts; sound-only clears are not counted by default
sources.rings: SOURCED: ISRID dementia distance from the IPP, km, 25/50/75/95%, Lost Person Behavior p. 164 (publisher's public sample https://www.dbs-sar.com/LPB/Dementia.pdf, read 2026-11-18): temperate mountain n = 95, temperate flat n = 175, urban n = 336; masses 0.25 per ring to 75%, 0.20 to 95%
sources.nearFeature: SOURCED: ISRID track offset, 75% within 71 m
sources.wedge: SOURCED: ISRID dispersion, 75% within 66 degrees each side (n = 11); factors 0.75 / (132/360) and 0.25 / (228/360)
sources.elevation: SOURCED: ISRID dementia elevation change from the IPP, temperate, uphill 19% / same 39% / downhill 42%, Lost Person Behavior p. 164 (publisher's public sample, read 2026-11-18; no n printed); OURS: levelBandM, the 3 m band for 'same', which the source does not define; no urban split, so the layer refuses urban terrain
